title: VTC — Vetting Event Mode — payload
description: A vetter asks to vet at a named event, at one of the rates the community publishes. The community answers where the request stands; it does not answer whether it was granted, because a vetter cannot raise its own cap and the group it would join may not exist yet.

eventId.description: The event, as the community names it. It is the whole anonymity set for anything spent under this event's tokens, so it names a gathering people attend — never one desk, one day or one vetter.

tier.description: One of the tiers the community publishes. A tier is picked from a menu rather than a number being named, so that no vetter's requested rate is itself a distinguishing detail.

Window.title: Event window
Window.description: The days the event runs. Dates, not timestamps: an hour would say when a vetter expects to be at a desk, and the tokens are day-scale anyway.

startDate.description: First day of the event, inclusive.

endDate.description: Last day of the event, inclusive. It is not before `startDate`.

Response.title: VTC Vetting Event Mode — response payload
Response.description: Where the request stands. `pending` is the ordinary answer to a first request and is not a refusal — a refusal is a `trust-task-error`.

state.description: `pending`: recorded, awaiting an approver and the group floor. `approved`: the event's label is live and this vetter may draw under it.

tier.description: The tier recorded for this vetter at this event.

groupSize.description: How many vetters have asked for this event so far, including this one. A count, never a list: who else is at the event is the anonymity set, and naming its members would hand out the very thing the set exists to hide.

groupFloor.description: How many vetters this community requires before an event may be approved at all. A one-vetter event is an event key with one holder, which is a name.

label.description: Present when `state` is `approved`: the token label to draw under, for `vtc/vetting/vetters/pcs-tokens`.

dripPerTick.description: Present when `state` is `approved`: how many tokens a tick under this label yields. It is the tier's rate, and it is the community's cap, not the vetter's request.

closesAfter.description: Present when `state` is `approved`: the last day this label will be accepted. It is after `window.endDate` by the community's grace period, so an applicant met on the final day still has time to submit.
